details.pr_title: Persist idempotency key before first capture

data.text:
I read PR #481 in acme/payments-api. It's titled "Persist idempotency key before first capture" by jordan, a small +14 -3 change confined to payments/retry.py that carries the idempotency key across the retry so a retried request cannot double-capture. That directly addresses the double-charge-on-retry bug, the change is scoped to the relevant file, and the checks were reported as passing with none failing or pending.

Since all checks were green, I merged it as planned. PR #481 is now merged into main, which deploys the fix to production. I did not need any other tools, and nothing was denied by CapAuth.

One thing worth flagging: the PR read gives an aggregate "checks: passing" status rather than a per-check breakdown, so I confirmed the overall state rather than inspecting each required check individually. If you want post-deploy confirmation, watching capture volume and duplicate-charge reports on the retry path would be the thing to check.
